newsitem.title: USA: PS Financial stake held by Conn. couple.
newsitem.headline: PS Financial stake held by Conn. couple.

text.p: Greenwich, Conn., couple Susan and Jerome Davis said Wednesday they have acquired a 9.86 percent stake or 215,200 common shares in PS Financial Inc, of Chicago.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Davises said they bought the shares between November 15 and December 6 at prices ranging from $10.00 to $11.875 a share.
The Davises, who are professional investors in small banking companies, said they bought the stake for investment purposes.
